comparison.objective: Secure a 2 kg monitor, release its stand latch, and place it upright on a foam mat while still held; candidate finishes threaded inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Load support coordinated with latch release and bulky-object transfer versus narrow mandrel alignment, bimanual hammering, safe withdrawal, and millimetre-fragment recovery.
comparison.success_condition: Monitor is secured before release, detached, upright on the mat, and still supported; candidate requires four fractures, zero fragment loss, and no component damage.
comparison.reason: Safe load-before-release sequencing is different from contact-loaded notch fracture. Both involve preventing loss, but the tested abilities are not interchangeable.
